scope_guards: Planning Data application records remain a discovery layer and do not replace the LBBD statutory register.
The 100,627-record and six-provider totals describe dataset coverage rather than national or borough completeness.
The 2025-09-17 collector date is retained and is not presented as current case freshness.
A zero-entry application-status dataset is not an exhaustive vocabulary or negative outcome proof.
One-provider condition coverage means absence cannot be interpreted as no conditions.
A point or blank geometry is not an application red-line or HMLR title polygon.
CSV, GeoJSON and API capability do not prove execution of a candidate-specific query.
No score or promotion is written without an exact authoritative case, current outcome, title relation and executed overlays.
